## ARRAY_AGG with INTERVAL values
# Sources: BigQuery's aggregate_functions#array_agg, for IGNORE NULLS, ORDER BY, LIMIT and NULL
# for no input; ORDER BY compares lengths, with 30 days to a month, as GoogleSQL's
# compliance/testdata/interval.test (orderby) does.

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(i) FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789' YEAR TO SECOND]) AS i
=> [{"v":"1-2 3 4:5:6.789"}]

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(i ORDER BY i)
FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 40 DAY, INTERVAL -1 SECOND, INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 2 HOUR]) AS i
=> [{"v":"0-0 0 -0:0:1"},{"v":"0-0 0 2:0:0"},{"v":"0-1 0 0:0:0"},{"v":"0-0 40 0:0:0"}]

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(i ORDER BY i DESC LIMIT 2)
FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 2 DAY, INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 40 DAY]) AS i
=> [{"v":"0-0 40 0:0:0"},{"v":"0-1 0 0:0:0"}]

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(i IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY i)
FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 1 MONTH, NULL, INTERVAL 1 DAY]) AS i
=> [{"v":"0-0 1 0:0:0"},{"v":"0-1 0 0:0:0"}]

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(i) IS NULL FROM UNNEST(CAST([] AS ARRAY<INTERVAL>)) AS i
=> "true"

SELECT STRING_AGG(TO_JSON_STRING(a), ' ' ORDER BY k) FROM (
  SELECT k, ARRAY_AGG(i) OVER (ORDER BY k ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS a
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS k, INTERVAL 1 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (3, INTERVAL -2 HOUR)])
)
=> "[\"P1D\"] [\"P1D\",\"P1M\"] [\"P1M\",\"PT-2H\"]"
